subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should existing bundled skill descriptions get concise trigger/WHEN wording now, or should trigger-like routing move to structured skill metadata/search first?
rationale: Current source still uses descriptions as a selection signal, but OpenClaw docs and prompt-budget behavior push descriptions to stay short, so automation should not choose the public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Land one focused metadata-only pass that adds short trigger-critical WHEN wording where it improves existing bundled skill routing without bloating descriptions.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions compact and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the canonical owner for explicit trigger semantics.

options.title: Fold into smart indexing
options.body: Treat this as a symptom of broader skill discovery and route remaining work through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89361.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Land one focused metadata-only pass that adds short trigger-critical WHEN wording where it improves existing bundled skill routing without bloating descriptions.

likelyOwner.reason: The current prompt formatter, loader, compact prompt fallback, and recent skill loading history route most directly through this area owner signal.
